questions.question: What are the eligibility criteria for the AICTE Tuition Fee Waiver Scheme (TFW)?
questions.reference_answer: TFW uses supernumerary seats; waiver to 2% of approved program seats by merit; parents' annual income from all sources at most Rs 8 lakh; valid income certificate issued by State Authorities; scholarships awarded after the admission cycle.
questions.notes: Provisional gold label derived from user-shared extracted document passages. Verify against original PDF before academic reporting.

questions.question: What is the maximum parental annual income allowed under AICTE TFW?
questions.reference_answer: Parents' annual income from all sources must not exceed Rs 8.00 lakhs per annum.

questions.question: What minimum CGPA is required for promotion to the next class under the B.Sc. academic system?

questions.question: What happens when a B.Sc. student has CGPA below 4.5 after the second semester?
questions.reference_answer: They must repeat the first year. This repeat opportunity is allowed only once; a CGPA again below 4.5 after the second semester requires discontinuing studentship.

questions.question: How many credits are required for a B.Sc. degree and for B.Sc. Honours or Honours with Research?
